column3: Near-identical statement of the established divine course among prior peoples and its non-substitution.
Supplies the immediately preceding destructive conduct whose consequence 33:62 frames as an established course.
Names God's established course among earlier servants and its irreversible loss for disbelievers.
Repeats the formula of God's course among those who passed before and its determined character.
Completes the local warning with the punitive outcome that 33:62 generalizes as God's established course.
Its replacement of one sign by another offers a limited boundary contrast to non-substitution of God's course.
States an unredirectable course governing prior messengers, closely illuminating the local expulsion pattern.
Treats prior courses and the outcomes of deniers as observable historical precedent.
Explicitly identifies the continuing course of earlier peoples in their refusal to believe.
Joins evil plotting, the return of its consequence, and the non-substitutable divine course.
Establishes the binding force of divine and messengerly decision within the nearby sequence.
